question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The price of wheat _____ has gone up in recent times.
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "flour" is the correct choice, as it refers to the finely ground powder obtained from grains like wheat. The price of wheat flour has indeed gone up recently.
 
• "Floor" refers to the surface of a room, building, or structure, which does not fit the context of wheat prices.
 
• "Flower" refers to the reproductive part of a plant, which is irrelevant in this context.
 
• "Follower" refers to a person who supports or admires someone, which does not fit the context of wheat prices either.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *"The price of wheat flour__ has gone up in recent times."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Floor (मंजिल)**: refers to the surface of a room, building, or structure, and is irrelevant in this context.
 
• **Flower (फूल)**: refers to the reproductive part of a plant, which is not related to wheat or its price.
 
• **Follower (अनुयायी)**: refers to someone who supports or admires a person, not a term related to wheat or its price.
